title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2026 MAR)
summary: A curated collection of community-submitted feature ideas for Dynamics 365 Business Central organized by functional area, covering improvements across finance, sales, purchasing, inventory, manufacturing, development, administration, and localization for the March 2026 release cycle.
key_points: The post aggregates hundreds of feature requests from the Business Central community across all major system areas
Ideas span development enhancements like native SQL READPAST support and improved AL debugging tools
Financial management suggestions include retained earnings closure by business unit and enhanced cash flow forecasting
Purchasing, sales, and inventory improvements focus on workflow automation and data synchronization
Localization requests include Swiss eBill integration and ZUGFeRD document embedding capabilities

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Frames the post as a compilation of potential improvements from the user community to enhance the platform
